'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***An [[Israel]]i security delegation arrives in [[Qatar]] for talks regarding a [[ceasefire]] deal and the release of Israeli hostages in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/top-israeli-security-delegation-doha-gaza-talks-2025-01-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israel–United States relations]], [[Calls for a ceasefire during the Gaza war]]
***[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] discuss efforts to reach a deal to solve the [[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|hostage crisis]] as well as a [[ceasefire]] to end the war. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/israel-hamas/2025/01/12/biden-netanyahu-israel-hamas-hostage-cease-fire/77655633007/ (''USA Today'')]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least eight [[Palestinians]] are killed in [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli airstrikes]] on areas of the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://english.news.cn/20250113/007ceff485b8479eb2a6bcb634f2f354/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
***The [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Army of the Democratic Republic of the Congo]] says that over the days it has recaptured several towns that fell to [[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] and other armed groups in [[North Kivu]] and [[South Kivu]] provinces.[https://apnews.com/article/congo-rebels-northkivu-goma-44d802cead4adde2b9aea5515bb83172 (AP)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**At least 40 people are killed during an attack by [[Boko Haram]] gunmen in Dumba, [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-massacre-boho-haram-3579523f5f1b978ea7d32b4374c8e036 (AP)]
**At least 16 civilians are killed in an [[airstrike]] conducted by the [[Nigerian Air Force]] in [[Zamfara State]], apparently after being mistaken for criminal gangs. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn0y30766kjo (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 California wildfires]]
**[[January 2025 Southern California wildfires]]
***[[Governor of California|California Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] states that the ongoing [[wildfire]]s impacting [[Los Angeles County, California|Los Angeles County]] could become the worst [[natural disaster]] in [[United States|American]] history "in terms of the scale and scope", amid current estimated damages of more than [[United States dollar|US$]]135 billion. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/fires-los-angeles-california-palisades-map-victim-latest-updates-b2677814.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.nbcnews.com/meet-the-press/video/gov-newsom-says-l-a-wildfires-could-be-worst-natural-disaster-in-u-s-history-full-interview-229078085843 (NBC News)]
***The death toll from the wildfires increases to 24. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckgy0pyvglpo (BBC News)]
***Officials say that the [[January 2025 Southern California wildfires#Kenneth Fire|Kenneth Fire]] has been contained. [https://www.cbsnews.com/losangeles/news/kenneth-fire-evacuations-in-west-hills-area/ (KCAL-TV)]
*A bus crashed on a highway in [[Al-Loud]], [[Libya]], killing 23 and injuring five. [https://english.news.cn/20250113/ab96976fd65b4bf4b25ab9da5f04f002/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)]
*Ten people are killed and several others are injured after large floods engulf the city of [[Ipatinga]] in [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvglwd34l81o.amp (BBC)]
*A bus fell down a 100-meter gorge in [[Pauri Garhwal district]], [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]], killing six and injuring 22. [https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/india/5-die-17-injured-as-bus-falls-into-gorge-in-uttarakhands-pauri/ (The Tribune)]
*Three people are killed and two others are injured in an [[avalanche]] in [[Trasquera]], [[Province of Verbano-Cusio-Ossola]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.rainews.it/articoli/2025/01/valanga-travolge-scialpinisti-in-piemonte-3-morti-e-2-feriti-trasquera-verbano-cusio-ossola-0186dba0-f920-4286-95de-4f72db97dbd4.html (Rai News)]
*At least 17 miners are trapped in a gold mine in [[Department of La Libertad|La Libertad Department]], [[Peru]], after a group of illegal miners attacked the mine. [https://english.news.cn/20250114/c17952037b594df4bdc2e8f0b23c8099/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[HMPV seasonal outbreak in China (2024–present)|HMPV seasonal outbreak in China]]
**The [[Bangladesh]]i [[Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research|IEDCR]] reports the country's first case of [[Human metapneumovirus|HMPV]] in [[Bhairab]], [[Dhaka Division]], Bangladesh. [https://www.newagebd.net/post/country/255169/iedcr-confirms-hmvp-case-in-bangladesh (''New Age'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Germany–Syria relations]]
**[[Minister for Foreign Affairs (Germany)|German Foreign Minister]] [[Annalena Baerbock]] pledges [[Euro|€]]50 million in food, emergency shelters, and medical care to [[Syria]] following talks with the [[First Syrian transitional government|Syrian transitional government]] in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germanys-baerbock-pledges-50m-for-syria-at-riyadh-talks/a-71276877 (DW)]
*Foreign ministers and senior officers of [[Arab world|Arab countries]], the [[European Union]], [[Turkey]], the [[United Kingdom]], and the [[United States]] hold a series of diplomatic meetings focused on [[Syria]] in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]]. [https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/648521/SAUDI-ARABIA/Riyadh-hosts-key-international-talks-on-Syrias-future (''Saudi Gazette'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024–25 Croatian presidential election]]
**[[Croatians]] vote in the second round to elect the [[President of Croatia|president]] between incumbent [[Zoran Milanović]] and former [[Ministry of Science and Education (Croatia)|science and education minister]] [[Dragan Primorac]]. [https://www.thedubrovniktimes.com/news/croatia/item/17378-croatia-votes-presidential-election-enters-decisive-second-round (''The Dubrovnik Times'')] [https://sarajevotimes.com/croatia-set-to-elect-president-in-pivotal-second-round-of-elections-2/ (''Sarajevo Times'')]
*[[2025 Comorian parliamentary election]]
**Voters in [[Comoros]] elect the 33 members of the [[Assembly of the Union of the Comoros|Assembly of the Union]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/voters-comoros-head-polls-elect-33-seat-parliament-2025-01-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ilza Amado Vaz]] unexpectedly resigns as [[Prime Minister of São Tomé and Príncipe]] three days after being appointed Prime Minister by [[President of São Tomé and Príncipe|President]] [[Carlos Vila Nova]]. The ruling [[Independent Democratic Action]] party then proposes Adelino Pereira to replace Vaz, but Vila Nova appoints [[Américo Ramos|Américo d'Oliveira dos Ramos]]. [https://english.news.cn/20250113/2fd3f6c7f9e148fbb544e1e0c52e0a10/c.html (Xinhua 1)], [https://english.news.cn/africa/20250113/bb2a5df8aecd44b58c904f3a522c43d3/c.html (Xinhua 2)]
